messages:
Mira: Heads-up — APAC embedding + rerank traffic spiking after the partner rollout. Seeing sustained 3x baseline qps overnight and a few 1-min bursts at ~6x. Need ops advice on cross-region provisioning and egress implications.
Oliver: Can you drop the forecast? GPU hours, peak qps windows, region spread?
Mira: Quick numbers:
```
- 7d forecast (APAC): 850 GPU-hours/day (baseline 280)
- Peak window: 0200-0500 UTC (local business hours APAC) ~6k qps for embeddings small batch jobs, rerank realtime ~1.2k qps
- Split: ~65% embeddings batch, 35% rerank realtime
- Expected sustained increase for 6 weeks
```
Raj: Ouch — cross-region egress will matter if we backhaul batch to US. Rough egress estimate?
Mira: If we keep batch in us-east and stream vectors, rough egress = 120 TB/mo -> ~$12k/mo at current rates. If we geo-home batch to ap-southeast1, egress drops < 5 TB/mo but ops complexity increases.
Sara: Network constraint note: current VPC peering link between us-east and ap-southeast is 10 Gbps aggregated. With the 6k qps spikes we can saturate during window if we funnel raw tensors. Need local batching or KV cache to avoid full model traffic.
infra-bot: [alert] apac-embed-pool-01 latency > 150ms x 3 mins at 1865432165 — auto-scale triggered (+2 instances).
Oliver: Proposal: spin up small realtime pools in APAC (4x small-GPU nodes) exclusively for rerank low-latency requests, and run embeddings batch in local batch-only spot pool with scheduled windows. Use prefix caching and compressed proto to reduce egress.
Raj: Cost tradeoff? Local realtime pools add reserved GPU cost (~$5k/mo for the small pool), but egress/cross-region infra + latency SLO penalties could be worse.
Mira: Rough blended estimate: keep batch local -> incremental infra + ops ~ $7k/mo, egress savings ~ $10k/mo -> net win. Realtime small pools bump reserved cost by ~ $5k/mo but saves ~200ms p99 latency.
Sara: Operational checklist before we flip:
- smoke test cross-region bandwidth with k6 for 30m
- validate prefix cache hit rates (~expected 20% warmups)
- ensure peer VPC MTU and jumbo frames enabled for bulk transfers
- add circuit alert for >80% peering util
Will run tests this afternoon.
Oliver: Config snippet for local pool rollout (for ops runbook):
```
pool:
  name: apac-rerank-rt-small
  model_variant: rerank-v2-q4_0
  nodes: 4
  gpu_type: a10g
  prewarm_kv: true
  max_surge: 2
  tags: [apac, rerank, realtime]
```
Raj: What about fallback policy if APAC pool OOMs or has preemptions?
Mira: Use routing rule: prefer apac pool -> fallback to us-east low-cost variant (rerank-v2-q4_0-quant) with degraded latency SLO and increase token cap. Also queue short 200ms waiting window with early-return for low-priority requests.
Sara: I'll add that flow to the runbook and link to playbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embed-rerank-geohoming (draft)
Oliver: I'll open infra ticket to provision the 4 nodes in ap-southeast with billing tag `proj-embed-apac`.
Mira: Approved. Tag the ticket with @billing and @security for KMS keys. Also include cost-center in request.
Raj: One more ask — can we run a simulated mixed workload to validate autoscale thresholds? If so, I'll compute worst-case GPU-hour burn and report tomorrow.
Sara: Yep — running sim now, will post results to thread. Expect initial sim finish ~ +2h.
Mira: Thanks all — main goals: avoid peering saturation, keep p99 latency for rerank under 180ms, and net reduce cross-region egress. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
